title: FBI 1992: Lanning's 'Investigator's Guide to Ritual Child Abuse'
summary: Supervisory Special Agent Kenneth V. Lanning (Behavioral Science Unit): no evidence of large-scale organized satanic cults abusing children in the US; crimes with bizarre/ritualistic elements do occur and must be distinguished from organized-cult claims; warned against suggestive interviewing. Frequently misquoted as a 'seven-year FBI study' — it is an investigator's guide, and Lanning did not declare all such claims a hoax.
